result.instructions: Tools for Folk, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Folk data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run folk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run folk_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run folk_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. folk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: folk_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the user associated with the current Folk API key. Folk REST: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: folk_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the Folk workspace (id, name, email) — useful for resolving owner ids. Folk REST: GET /v1/users.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

tools.name: folk_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List/filter people (contacts). Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/people.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

combinator.description: How to combine multiple filters — 'and' (all must match) or 'or' (any). Default 'and'.

filter.description: Structured filter: attribute → operator → value, expanded to filter[attribute][operator]=value query keys. Example: {"firstName":{"eq":"John"}}.

tools.name: folk_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List/filter companies. Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

combinator.description: How to combine multiple filters — 'and' (all must match) or 'or' (any). Default 'and'.

filter.description: Structured filter: attribute → operator → value, expanded to filter[attribute][operator]=value query keys. Example: {"firstName":{"eq":"John"}}.

tools.name: folk_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups in the Folk workspace (ids needed to place people/companies). Folk REST: GET /v1/groups.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

tools.name: folk_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally scoped to an entity or filtered by full text and creation date. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

entity_id.description: Restrict to notes on this entity (person/company) id — maps to query key entity.id.

created_after.description: Only notes created after this ISO 8601 timestamp — maps to query createdAfter.

created_before.description: Only notes created before this ISO 8601 timestamp — maps to query createdBefore.

tools.name: folk_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Get a single note by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). All fields are optional. Folk REST: POST /v1/people.

fullName.description: Full name (if not split into first/last).

gender.description: Gender — one of Male, Female, Unknown, Other.

groups.description: Groups to add this person to (array of {id}).

items.description: A reference to a group by id.

companies.description: Companies this person is linked to (array of {id} or {name}).

items.description: A reference to a company by id or by name.

customFieldValues.description: Custom field values, keyed by field.

tools.name: folk_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields are changed; list-valued fields (emails, phones, groups, companies, etc.) REPLACE the existing values. Folk REST: PATCH /v1/people/{id}.

gender.description: Gender — one of Male, Female, Unknown, Other.

items.description: A reference to a group by id.

companies.description: Replace the person's linked companies (array of {id} or {name}).

items.description: A reference to a company by id or by name.

customFieldValues.description: Custom field values, keyed by field.

tools.name: folk_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: Create a new company. `name` is required. Folk REST: POST /v1/companies.

lastFundingDate.description: Date of last funding round, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

groups.description: Groups to add this company to (array of {id}).

items.description: A reference to a group by id.

customFieldValues.description: Custom field values, keyed by field.

tools.name: folk_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Create a note attached to an entity (person/company). Folk REST: POST /v1/notes.

entity_id.description: Id of the entity (person/company) to attach the note to — maps to body entity:{id}.

parent_note_id.description: Id of a parent note to reply under — maps to body parentNote:{id}.
